case.name: task-facts-from-files
case.expected_output: Reads the worklog and data first; proposes found facts (VP next Thursday, trial 14→7 days, onboarding complaints) as context to confirm instead of asking for them.
expectations: The response mentions at least one fact found in notes/worklog.md (VP review next Thursday, trial cut from 14 to 7 days, or onboarding complaints)
Found facts are presented for the user to confirm rather than asked as open questions
The response still asks the user something only they can answer, such as the purpose or what done looks like
